title: [C++ Fake] fake dispatch tables for decomps/op_impl/prim
body:
creating tables on C++ side for decomps/op_impls/prims so that C++ faketensor will have all necessary info on C++ side before deciding whether or not to cross into Python to run decomps/op_impls/etc

adding the additional registrations to `torch/_prims/__init__.py`, `torch/_decomp/__init__.py`, `torch/_subclasses/fake_impls.py`

rn there will be 2 tables (one in python one in c++) but can revisit in a followup pr if its worth removing the python one after migration is complete
